title: Nahau (Theme 7: Matunda na mimea)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the meaning of the whole nahau, not of its words, and uses it in a sentence about good conduct.
representations: nahau cards with a picture of the literal meaning
steps: Notice the literal picture is wrong.
contexts: a class with a talkative pupil

board.say: Je, mtu anapiga moyo wake kweli?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child gives the meaning (to take courage) and writes a sentence with it.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nahau "kupiga moyo konde" ina maana gani?" Kwa nini "kupiga moyo kwa fimbo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau ni maneno yenye maana tofauti na maneno yenyewe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nahau "kula kiapo" ina maana gani?" Kwa nini "kuvumilia shida" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila nahau ina maana yake. Linganisha maneno ya nahau na maana kabla ya kuchagua.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nahau ipi?" Kwa nini "Haba na haba hujaza kibaba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau ni kifungu kifupi chenye maana maalum. Methali ni sentensi nzima yenye funzo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Alipiga moyo ___ akaendelea kusoma." Kwa nini "kubwa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau hutumia maneno yale yale: kupiga moyo konde, kujikaza kisabuni, kula kiapo, kukata tamaa.

checks.question: Tumia "kupiga moyo konde" katika sentensi.
checks.answer: Alipiga moyo konde akaendelea na mtihani.
